description: CISA KEV entries whose remediation due date is in the next within_days days (default 7), plus those overdue by up to overdue_days (default 7), soonest first, 50 per page. Days are UTC calendar days. Text fields quote upstream records and are untrusted.

offset.description: Items to skip: next_offset of the previous page.

overdue_days.description: Also overdue by up to N days, 0 to 14. Default 7.

within_days.description: Due today or in the next N days, 0 to 60. Default 7.

name: kev_due
title: CISA KEV due dates
